meta_description: Gold Decorating Ltd provides interior and exterior painting and decorating across Leeds. Free quotes, reliable local team. Call 07507 107664.
hero_subhead: Your home deserves a fresh look. We transform interiors and exteriors with meticulous attention to detail and lasting results.
services_subhead: From interior redecorating to exterior cladding and commercial work, we handle every aspect of painting and decorating with professional standards.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Full room refreshes including wallpaper hanging, emulsion and gloss finishes. We prepare surfaces properly so paint lasts years, not months.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant finishes for render, brick and wood. We use masonry paints and protective coatings that stand up to Yorkshire weather.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Doors, windows, skirting and architrave painted to a high gloss finish. All surfaces properly undercoated and sanded between coats.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Pattern matching and specialist wallpapers fitted flush. We work on challenging walls and ensure seams are invisible.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office, retail and industrial spaces redecorated on schedule with minimal disruption. We work around your business hours.

services.title: Surface Preparation & Repairs
services.desc: Crack filling, plasterboard patching and damp treatment before painting. Proper prep is where a quality finish begins.

about_pullquote: We prepare properly and never cut corners — that's what sets us apart.
about_para_1: Gold Decorating was founded in 2009 to bring consistent, honest decorating to Leeds homeowners tired of cowboys and bodged jobs. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation for thorough preparation, attention to detail, and reliable workmanship. Our team is fully trained in modern paint systems and traditional techniques alike.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we show up on time, protect their homes and belongings, and deliver results that last. We're not the cheapest — we're the best value. Every project, no matter the size, gets the same care and professionalism.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Gold Decorating

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge and hallway. The lads were tidy, professional and finished bang on schedule. Didn't rush anything — every coat was done right. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had our Victorian terrace redecorated inside and out. They sorted woodwork, wallpaper and render — took time to match colours and patterns perfectly. Best decorators we've used in 20 years here.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: Needed a quick turnaround for a commercial space before opening day. Gold Decorating came through with flying colours, literally. Professional, clean and efficient. Will be using them again.
reviews.author: David P.
